title: The Rights of Children over Parents in Tarbiyah and Education

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents, mentioning Prophetic hadiths that urge the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It clarifies the importance of justice among children and not favoring one over another. It also highlights the necessity of teaching them Salah and good akhlaq (character).

review_defects.why: Islamic terms are transliterated inconsistently: 'Tarbiyah' is transliterated in the title without a gloss, but glossed as 'tarbiyah (upbringing)' in the text; 'Salah' is transliterated without a gloss; 'akhlaq' is transliterated with a gloss; while 'التعليم' is translated as 'Education' rather than transliterated. This mixed approach may confuse readers and lacks a consistent policy for handling Islamic terminology.
